proof_body:
by
  intro Ω ι _ P _ X a b s ε hX hI hB hε
  have hI' : ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun i ω => X i ω - ∫ ω', X i ω' ∂P) P :=
    hI.comp (fun i x => x - ∫ ω', X i ω' ∂P) (fun i => measurable_id.sub_const _)
  have hS : ∀ i ∈ s, ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω => X i ω - ∫ ω', X i ω' ∂P) ((‖b i - a i‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) P :=
    fun i _ => ProbabilityTheory.hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc (hX i).aemeasurable (hB i)
  have h := ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF.measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun hI' hS hε
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  congr 1
  have e : ((∑ i ∈ s, ((‖b i - a i‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 : NNReal) : NNReal) : ℝ) = (∑ i ∈ s, (b i - a i) ^ 2) / 4 := by
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, div_pow, sq_abs]
    norm_num
  rw [e]
  by_cases h0 : ∑ i ∈ s, (b i - a i) ^ 2 = 0
  · simp [h0]
  · field_simp
    ring
target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : ι → Ω → ℝ) (a b : ι → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (ε : ℝ), (∀ i, Measurable (X i)) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P → (∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, X i ω ∈ Set.Icc (a i) (b i)) → 0 ≤ ε → P.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (X i ω - ∫ ω', X i ω' ∂P)} ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ε ^ 2 / ∑ i ∈ s, (b i - a i) ^ 2)
